An AI Chatbot is a software that can
interact with users in natural language.
It simulates human conversation using
text or voice.
Uses Natural Language Processing (NLP)
to understand and respond.
Can handle multiple queries instantly
without human intervention.
Introduction – What
is an AI Chatbot?

Role of NLP in Chatbots
NLP helps chatbots understand human
language.
Converts user input into structured data.
Key tasks:
Text understanding
Intent detection
Entity extraction
Enables meaningful and context-aware
responses.

Widely used in customer support systems
Examples:
Order tracking
Complaint handling
FAQs automation
Used by companies like:
Amazon
Flipkart
Banking apps

A mathematical model consisting of states and transitions

voice assistants, making communication faster, easier, and more efficient.
